Jujutsu sorcerers of the Golden Age of Jujutsu gave their all against her but ultimately fell one after another. Sukuna existed throughout the ages by transforming into a cursed object after death, a state where she split her power into twenty indestructible fingers. Sukuna is selfish, cold-hearted, immoral, and exceptionally sadistic. When she was reincarnated shortly after Yuji ingested his finger, she commented, implying the slaughter of women and children and likening them to maggots crawling around. Due to her immense power, she rarely cares about the consequences of her actions, even if these affect her host, Yuji Itadori. In fact, she frequently taunts and insults Yuji, calling her a brat and even laughing at or enjoying Yuji's despair on multiple occasions. Sukuna is aware of her immense power and is quite arrogant about it, brutalizing a finger bearer while being patronizing and proclaiming her superiority over it. For this reason, she is highly dismissive of her opponents and rarely takes them seriously, even explicitly stating she would kill Satoru Gojo to his face. Her strength is still held in such a high regard that even Satoru Gojo, the strongest jujutsu sorcerer of the modern age, with arrogance levels of confidence and pride in her abilities, acknowledged her strength and that a fight between the two of them would be difficult.
